report:
Liver, segment 3, wedge resection

Received in formalin is a wedge resection specimen (segment 3) measuring 60 x 40 x 30 mm and weighing 35 g. There is a single tumour measuring 24 x 22 x 20 mm. The nodule is well circumscribed, yellow and necrotic, 6 mm from the parenchymal margin. Representative sections are taken; see block key.

(1-4) Tumour.
(5) Tumour with nearest parenchymal margin.
(6) Background liver.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Wedge resection
- Tumour site: Segment 3
- Tumour focality: Solitary
- Tumour size: 2.4 cm (largest tumour, greatest dimension)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Hepatocellular carcinoma
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is completely necrotic, with no viable tumour cells.
- Tumour extension: Tumour confined to liver
- Satellitosis: Not identified
- Vascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Treatment effect: Complete necrosis (no viable tumour), after TACE

Margins
- Parenchymal margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 6 mm

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: ypT0

Additional findings
- Cirrhosis (Ishak stage 6/6)
- Chronic hepatitis (hepatitis B)

LIVER, segment 3, wedge resection
- COMPLETELY NECROTIC NODULE after TACE, consistent with treated HEPATOCELLULAR
  CARCINOMA; no viable tumour
- Stage ypT0 (pTNM, AJCC 8th edition)
- Margin clear
- CHRONIC HEPATITIS B with CIRRHOSIS (Ishak stage 6/6)
